description: This file defines an interface IStorageHasherPicker for selecting hash functions in Orleans storage, including a property for hash providers and a method for picking a hasher based on various parameters.

classes.name: IStorageHasherPicker
classes.description: An interface for selecting hash functions for storage in Orleans, supporting thread safety and customization.

methods.name: PickHasher
methods.description: Selects an appropriate hasher based on provided parameters such as service ID, grain type, grain ID, grain state, and an optional tag.
